title: Menu
metaTitle: Menu — Amber Inn Bar & Grill, Eau Claire
metaDescription: Half-pound burgers ground behind the bar, the Friday fish fry, draft root beer and ten taps. The full Amber Inn menu with prices, as text.

data.heading: The menu
data.intro: Everything is cooked behind the bar. Prices are on the board and here.

items.question: When does the kitchen close?
items.answer: Kitchen hours are separate from bar hours. Tonight's kitchen close is on the front page, live, and on the Visit page.

items.question: Which day is the fish fry?
items.answer: Friday. See the fish fry page for the time and price.

items.question: Can I bring kids?
items.answer: Yes, with an adult, while the kitchen is open.

items.question: Is there a vegetarian option?
items.answer: The kitchen will tell you what they can do that day. Draft root beer is always on.

data.heading: Bringing a group?
data.subtitle: Birthdays, Packer parties, the work crew. Tell us the date and headcount.
